business_summary.text: Kapston Services is an end-to-end manpower solutions provider offering staffing, security, and facility management services across various sectors including manufacturing, pharma, IT, and healthcare.

call_points.text: Management expects continued growth in manpower services with focus on operational efficiency
Increasing demand for workforce solutions PAN India
EBITDA margin improved to 6.36% in Q4FY26 from 5.18% in Q4FY25

corporate_actions.subject: Face Value Split (Sub-Division) - From Rs 10/- Per Share To Rs 5/- Per Share

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company received a demand of Rs. 1,21,11,680 from the Assessing Officer for the financial year 2016-17, vide dated April 9, 2019. The Commissioner of Income Tax dismissed the Assessing Officer's order, leading to an appeal by the Department to the Tribunal. However, the Tribunal struck down the appeal on 27.08.2021. Subsequently on April 11, 2022, the Principal Commissioner of Income Tax-2, Hyderabad, submitted an appeal to the Telangana High Court.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: (Pr. Commissioner of Income Tax) Income Tax Department, Hyderabad
